# Copilot Instructions

This repository is a public, sanitized version of a private Hermes Agent content
operations workflow. When helping with changes:

- Keep credentials out of the repository.
- Prefer deterministic samples over live API calls.
- Keep WeChat publishing draft-first and never auto-publish by default.
- Preserve human review for Xiaohongshu video/audio/text qualification.
- Add tests or audit checks when adding new public-facing workflow evidence.
- Explain before/after impact in docs, because this repo is also a challenge
  submission package.
